## Process survey data: 

```{r}
survey_tidy <-here::here("data-raw/nurses-stress/survey-results.csv.gz") %>% 
  read() %>% 
  tidy_survey_dates()
survey_long <- survey_tidy %>% 
  survey_to_long()
  
```

##Joining data sets: 
```{r}
nurses_stress <- survey_long %>% 
  full_join(survey_tidy) %>% 
  full_join(hr_data) %>% 
  full_join(ibi_data) %>% 
  full_join(Temp_data) %>% 
  full_join(bvp_data) %>% 
  full_join(eda_data)
nurses_stress %>% 
  view()


```
